### K pair_base leaves token unbound **Medium Severity** `k_vnni::detail::pair_base` computes the scatter/gather address from `token` with no `token < Rows` check, and `store_row` / `load_row` call it directly. Packed V asserts this in `v_vnni_access::pair_base` on every bulk op, including release builds. An out-of-range token here becomes a 64-dword scatter or gather off the 16 KiB plane.
Additional Locations (1) - [`h/tron/tensor/k_vnni.hpp#L285-L317`](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/a711aeee831c7c4da24ce3737d93dd0c76df1149/h/tron/tensor/k_vnni.hpp#L285-L317)
